third_addendum_update_scope.interpretation: The 2026 consolidated volume contains the nitrate/nitrite fact sheet, but the fact sheet itself states an assessment date of 2016. The WHO summary of the third-addendum updates does not identify nitrate/nitrite as a newly reassessed chemical topic.

interpretation_limits: The 2026-06-17 date is the publication date of the consolidated fourth edition incorporating the third addendum; it is not the nitrate/nitrite chemical assessment date.
The WHO values are international drinking-water guidance, not Georgian law or an automatic threshold for raw environmental groundwater.
A combined nitrate/nitrite ratio requires paired measurements from the same sample, collection time and water matrix, reported on compatible ion bases.
No paired Georgian sample-level data are available in this record; no combined ratio or local compliance result is calculated.
The 0.226 and 0.304 conversion factors are source-published rounded factors and must not be used as the sole basis for a near-threshold legal decision.
